<!--
Analysis code for "Beyond the Facility Walls: A Geospatial Analysis on Supervised
Consumption Sites and Its Neighborhood Effects" (Cho & Park, NHSJS Reports, Nov. 6, 2026).
Written by Kayla Park in R. Data sources: NYC Open Data (EMS Incident Dispatch Data,
76xm-jjuj; 311 Service Requests, erm2-nwe9 and 76ig-c548), U.S. Census Bureau ACS
ZIP code tables, and Census TIGER/Line ZCTA shapefiles. Place the downloaded files
in a data/ folder next to this file.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(lubridate)
library(table1)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
file_path <- "data/"
```

```{r}
syringe_2010 <- read.csv(paste0(file_path, "311_Service_Requests_from_2010.csv"))
syringe_2020 <- read.csv(paste0(file_path, "311_Service_Requests_from_2020.csv"))
df_scs <- read_csv("data/scs_locations.csv")
EMS <- read.csv(paste0(file_path, "EMS_Incident_Dispatch_Data.csv"))
```

```{r}
# NA clean for all datasets
syringe_2010 <- syringe_2010 %>% 
    drop_na(Longitude)

syringe_2020 <- syringe_2020 %>% 
    drop_na(Longitude)

syringe <- rbind(syringe_2010,syringe_2020)

syringe <- syringe %>% 
    mutate(
        Created.Date = mdy(Created.Date)
    )

EMS <- EMS %>% 
    mutate(INCIDENT_DATETIME = mdy(INCIDENT_DATETIME))
```

```{r}
# Split data to pre and post sites

pre_EMS <- EMS %>% 
    filter((INCIDENT_DATETIME < as.Date("2021-11-30") & INCIDENT_DATETIME > as.Date("2021-06-15")) | (INCIDENT_DATETIME < as.Date("2020-03-01") & INCIDENT_DATETIME > as.Date("2018-07-15")))
post_EMS <- EMS %>% 
    filter(INCIDENT_DATETIME > as.Date("2022-06-01") & INCIDENT_DATETIME < as.Date("2024-07-01"))

pre_syringe <- syringe %>% 
    filter((Created.Date < as.Date("2021-11-30") & Created.Date > as.Date("2021-06-15")) | (Created.Date < as.Date("2020-03-01") & Created.Date > as.Date("2018-07-15")))
post_syringe <- syringe %>% 
    filter(Created.Date > as.Date("2022-06-01") & Created.Date < as.Date("2023-02-15"))
```

```{r}
nyc_shp <- read_sf("data/tl_2025_us_zcta520/tl_2025_us_zcta520.shp")
nyc_shp <- nyc_shp %>% 
    mutate(ZCTA5CE20 = as.numeric(ZCTA5CE20)) %>% 
    filter(ZCTA5CE20 >= 10001 & ZCTA5CE20 <= 10282 & ZCTA5CE20 != 10044 & ZCTA5CE20 != 10177)
nyc_shp <- st_transform(nyc_shp, 32618)
```

```{r}
pre_EMS_counts <- pre_EMS %>% 
    count(ZIPCODE)
pre_EMS_counts <- pre_EMS_counts %>% 
    rename(pre_EMS_counts_per_zipcode = n) %>% 
    drop_na(pre_EMS_counts_per_zipcode)
post_EMS_counts <- post_EMS %>% 
    count(ZIPCODE)
post_EMS_counts <- post_EMS_counts %>% 
    rename(post_EMS_counts_per_zipcode = n) %>% 
    drop_na(post_EMS_counts_per_zipcode)

```

```{r}
nyc_shp_EMS <- nyc_shp %>% 
    left_join(pre_EMS_counts, by = join_by(ZCTA5CE20 == ZIPCODE)) %>% 
    mutate(pre_EMS_counts_per_zipcode = replace_na(pre_EMS_counts_per_zipcode, 0))
nyc_shp_EMS <- nyc_shp_EMS %>% 
    left_join(post_EMS_counts, by = join_by(ZCTA5CE20 == ZIPCODE)) %>% 
    mutate(post_EMS_counts_per_zipcode = replace_na(post_EMS_counts_per_zipcode, 0))
nyc_shp_EMS <- nyc_shp_EMS %>% 
    drop_na(pre_EMS_counts_per_zipcode, post_EMS_counts_per_zipcode)
```

```{r}
zip_neighbors <- poly2nb(nyc_shp_EMS)
```

```{r}
lw <- nb2listw(zip_neighbors, style = "W")
```

```{r}
moran <- moran.test(nyc_shp_EMS$pre_EMS_counts_per_zipcode, lw)
print(moran)
moran_post <- moran.test(nyc_shp_EMS$post_EMS_counts_per_zipcode, lw)
print(moran_post)
```

```{r}
pre_syringe_final <- pre_syringe %>% 
    select(Latitude, Longitude) %>% 
    mutate(Period = "Pre")
post_syringe_final <- post_syringe %>% 
    select(Latitude, Longitude) %>% 
    mutate(Period = "Post")
syringe_final <- rbind(pre_syringe_final, post_syringe_final)
```

```{r}
syringes_sf <- st_as_sf(syringe_final, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
syringes_sf <- st_transform(syringes_sf, 32618)
```

```{r}
pre_syringe_counts <- pre_syringe %>% 
    count(Incident.Zip) %>% 
    rename(pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode = n) #%>% 
    #drop_na(pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode)
post_syringe_counts <- post_syringe %>% 
    count(Incident.Zip) %>% 
    rename(post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode = n) #%>% 
    #drop_na(post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode)
```

```{r}
nyc_shp_syringe <- nyc_shp %>% 
    left_join(pre_syringe_counts, by = join_by(ZCTA5CE20 == Incident.Zip)) %>% 
    mutate(pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode = replace_na(pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode, 0))
nyc_shp_syringe <- nyc_shp_syringe %>% 
    left_join(post_syringe_counts, by = join_by(ZCTA5CE20 == Incident.Zip)) %>%
    mutate(post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode = replace_na(post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode, 0))
```

```{r}

lw <- nb2listw(zip_neighbors, style = "W")
moran <- moran.test(nyc_shp_syringe$pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode, lw)
print(moran)
moran_post <- moran.test(nyc_shp_syringe$post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode, lw)
```

```{r}
# site zipcodes: 10033 and 10035

df_scs <- df_scs |> 
  filter(`Site Type` == "SCS")
sites_shp <- st_as_sf(df_scs, coords=c("Longitude","Latitude"), crs=4326)
sites_shp <- st_transform(sites_shp, 32618)
sites_buffer_shp <- st_buffer(sites_shp, dist=1000)
sites_in_zip_shp <- st_join(nyc_shp_EMS, sites_shp, join = st_contains)
nyc_shp_EMS$has_site <- !is.na(sites_in_zip_shp$`Site Type`)
treated_zip_codes <- nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20[nyc_shp_EMS$has_site]
```

```{r}
syringes_sf$treated <- as.integer(lengths(st_within(syringes_sf, sites_buffer_shp)) > 0)
syringes_sf$Period <- if_else(syringes_sf$Period=="Pre", 0, 1)
```

```{r}
did_data <- syringes_sf %>%
  group_by(Period, treated) %>%
  summarise(events = n())
```

```{r}
est <- coef(socio_model)
se <- summary(socio_model)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]
OR <- exp(est)
ci_low <- exp(est - 1.96 * se)
ci_high <- exp(est + 1.96 * se)
data.frame(term = names(est), estimate = est, OR = OR, CI_lower = ci_low, CI_upper = ci_high, p = summary(socio_model)$coefficients[,4])
```

```{r rebuild-libs}
library(fixest)
library(HonestDiD)

ANCHOR      <- as.Date("2021-12-01")   # first full post-opening month
OPEN_DATE   <- as.Date("2021-11-30")
PHASEIN_END <- as.Date("2022-05-31")
COVID_START <- as.Date("2020-03-01")
COVID_END   <- as.Date("2021-07-01")
EMS_START   <- as.Date("2018-07-01")
WIN_END     <- as.Date("2024-07-01")
```

## Verify treatment assignment before anything else

```{r verify-sites}
site_zips <- sapply(st_within(sites_shp, nyc_shp_EMS),
                    \(i) if (length(i) == 1) nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20[i] else NA_real_)
print(site_zips)
stopifnot(nrow(sites_shp) == 2, setequal(site_zips, c(10035, 10033)))

treated_zip_codes    <- site_zips
contig_list          <- unique(unlist(nb[which(nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20 %in% site_zips)]))
contiguous_zip_codes <- nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20[contig_list]
nyc_shp_EMS$treated  <- nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20 %in% c(treated_zip_codes, contiguous_zip_codes)

cat("Treated ZIPs:", sum(nyc_shp_EMS$treated), "of", nrow(nyc_shp_EMS), "\n")
```

## Geography lookup: distance bands and per-site assignment

```{r geo-lookup}
cent    <- st_centroid(nyc_shp_EMS)
dist_m  <- apply(st_distance(cent, sites_shp), 1, min) |> as.numeric()

near_of <- function(z) {
  i <- which(nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20 == z)
  unique(c(z, nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20[nb[[i]]]))
}
near_eh <- near_of(10035); near_wh <- near_of(10033)

geo <- nyc_shp_EMS %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    ZIPCODE    = ZCTA5CE20,
    treated    = as.integer(treated),
    Population = as.numeric(as.character(Population)),
    dist_mi    = dist_m / 1609.34,
    band       = relevel(cut(dist_mi, c(-Inf,.5,1,2,3,Inf),
                             labels = c("0-0.5mi","0.5-1mi","1-2mi","2-3mi","3mi+")),
                         ref = "3mi+"),
    site       = case_when(ZIPCODE %in% near_eh ~ "EastHarlem",
                           ZIPCODE %in% near_wh ~ "WashHeights",
                           TRUE ~ "Control")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Population), Population > 0)

# 1,000 m buffer definition, kept as an alternative specification
buf_zip <- nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20[lengths(st_intersects(nyc_shp_EMS, sites_buffer_shp)) > 0]
```

## Panel builder

```{r panel-builder}
build_panel <- function(dat, zip_col, date_col, start, end, label) {
  counts <- dat %>%
    transmute(ZIPCODE = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[zip_col]])),
              month   = floor_date(.data[[date_col]], "month")) %>%
    filter(ZIPCODE %in% geo$ZIPCODE, month >= start, month <= end) %>%
    count(ZIPCODE, month, name = "y")

  expand_grid(ZIPCODE = geo$ZIPCODE,
              month   = seq(start, end, by = "month")) %>%
    left_join(counts, by = c("ZIPCODE","month")) %>%
    mutate(y = replace_na(y, 0)) %>%
    left_join(geo, by = "ZIPCODE") %>%
    mutate(month_fe  = factor(month),
           rel_month = interval(ANCHOR, month) %/% months(1),
           post      = as.integer(month >  PHASEIN_END),
           phasein   = as.integer(month >= ANCHOR & month <= PHASEIN_END),
           outcome   = label)
}

drop_covid <- function(p) p %>% filter(!(month >= COVID_START & month < COVID_END))
```

## EMS panel

```{r ems-panel}
ems_full <- build_panel(EMS, "ZIPCODE", "INCIDENT_DATETIME", EMS_START, WIN_END, "EMS")
ems_es   <- drop_covid(ems_full)

cat("Rows:", nrow(ems_es), " ZIPs:", n_distinct(ems_es$ZIPCODE),
    " Months:", n_distinct(ems_es$month), "\n")
print(table(treated = ems_es$treated, post = ems_es$post))
```

## Event studies and pre-trend tests

```{r event-study}
fit_es <- function(p)
  fepois(y ~ i(rel_month, treated, ref = -1) | ZIPCODE + month_fe,
         data = p, offset = ~log(Population), cluster = ~ZIPCODE)

es_ems <- fit_es(ems_es); es_syr <- fit_es(syr_es)
iplot(es_ems, main = "EMS calls"); iplot(es_syr, main = "311 syringe complaints")

wald(es_ems, keep = "rel_month::-")
wald(es_syr, keep = "rel_month::-")
```

### Three-window decomposition on the full panel

```{r pretrend-windows}
es_ems_full <- fit_es(ems_full)
iplot(es_ems_full, main = "EMS, including pandemic months")

pre_window <- function(m, lo, hi) {
  tm  <- grep("^rel_month::", names(coef(m)), value = TRUE)
  r   <- as.integer(sub(".*rel_month::(-?[0-9]+):.*", "\\1", tm))
  sel <- sort(r[r >= lo & r <= hi])
  if (!length(sel)) return(NULL)
  wald(m, keep = paste0("rel_month::(", paste(sel, collapse = "|"), "):"))
}
pre_window(es_ems_full, -41, -22)   # Jul 2018 - Feb 2020
pre_window(es_ems_full, -21,  -6)   # Mar 2020 - Jun 2021 (pandemic)
pre_window(es_ems_full,  -5,  -2)   # Jul - Oct 2021
```

### Syringe pre-trend windows

```{r syr-pretrend-windows}
es_syr_full <- fit_es(syr_full)
pre_window(es_syr_full, -25, -22)   # Nov 2019 - Feb 2020
pre_window(es_syr_full,  -5,  -2)   # Jul - Oct 2021
```

### Small-sample joint test (CR2)

```{r boot-joint}
library(clubSandwich)

boot_window <- function(p, lo, hi) {
  lin <- feols(I(y/Population*1e4) ~ i(rel_month, treated, ref = -1) | ZIPCODE + month_fe,
               data = p)
  tm  <- grep("^rel_month::", names(coef(lin)), value = TRUE)
  r   <- as.integer(sub(".*rel_month::(-?[0-9]+):.*", "\\1", tm))
  sel <- tm[r >= lo & r <= hi]
  if (!length(sel)) return(NULL)
  Wald_test(lin, constraints = constrain_zero(sel), vcov = "CR2",
            cluster = p$ZIPCODE, test = "HTZ")
}

try_window <- function(p, lo, hi, lab) {
  out <- tryCatch(boot_window(p, lo, hi), error = function(e) NULL)
  cat("\n", lab, ": ")
  if (is.null(out)) cat("not computable (rank-deficient contrast)\n") else print(out)
}

try_window(ems_full, -41, -22, "EMS pre-COVID")
try_window(ems_full, -21,  -6, "EMS pandemic")
try_window(ems_full,  -5,  -2, "EMS pre-opening")
try_window(syr_full, -25, -22, "Syringe early")
try_window(syr_full,  -5,  -2, "Syringe pre-opening")
```

## Alternative comparison groups

```{r alt-controls}
pre_prof <- ems_es %>% filter(month < OPEN_DATE) %>%
  group_by(ZIPCODE) %>%
  summarise(mu = 1e4*sum(y)/sum(Population),
            sl = coef(lm(y ~ as.numeric(month)))[[2]], .groups = "drop")
tr_mu <- mean(pre_prof$mu[pre_prof$ZIPCODE %in% geo$ZIPCODE[geo$treated==1]])
tr_sl <- mean(pre_prof$sl[pre_prof$ZIPCODE %in% geo$ZIPCODE[geo$treated==1]])
matched <- pre_prof %>% filter(!ZIPCODE %in% geo$ZIPCODE[geo$treated==1]) %>%
  mutate(d = sqrt(((mu-tr_mu)/sd(mu))^2 + ((sl-tr_sl)/sd(sl))^2)) %>%
  slice_min(d, n = 20) %>% pull(ZIPCODE)

ctrl_sets <- list(
  "All Manhattan"      = geo$ZIPCODE,
  "Donut (>2mi)"       = geo$ZIPCODE[geo$treated == 1 | geo$dist_mi > 2],
  "Matched pre-period" = c(geo$ZIPCODE[geo$treated==1], matched),
  "1,000m buffer"      = geo$ZIPCODE)

alt <- imap_dfr(ctrl_sets, function(zs, nm) {
  map_dfr(list(EMS = ems_es, Syringe = syr_es), function(p) {
    dd <- p %>% filter(ZIPCODE %in% zs)
    if (nm == "1,000m buffer")
      dd <- dd %>% mutate(treated = as.integer(ZIPCODE %in% buf_zip),
                          post = post)
    m <- fepois(y ~ treated:post | ZIPCODE + month_fe, data = dd,
                offset = ~log(Population), cluster = ~ZIPCODE)
    tibble(control_set = nm, outcome = unique(p$outcome), n_zip = n_distinct(dd$ZIPCODE),
           pct = 100*(exp(coef(m)[["treated:post"]])-1), p = pvalue(m)[["treated:post"]])
  }, .id = "which")
})
print(alt)
```

## Randomization inference (primary p-value)

```{r rand-inf}
ri_p <- function(p, B = 1000) {
  obs  <- coef(fepois(y ~ treated:post | ZIPCODE + month_fe, data = p,
                      offset = ~log(Population)))[["treated:post"]]
  cand <- geo$ZIPCODE[geo$dist_mi > 2]
  draws <- map_dbl(seq_len(B), function(i) {
    fh <- sample(cand, 2)
    fn <- unique(unlist(lapply(fh, near_of)))
    dd <- p %>% mutate(tp = as.integer(ZIPCODE %in% fn) * post)
    tryCatch(coef(fepois(y ~ tp | ZIPCODE + month_fe, data = dd,
                         offset = ~log(Population)))[["tp"]],
             error = function(e) NA_real_)
  })
  tibble(observed = obs, null_sd = sd(draws, na.rm = TRUE),
         ri_p = mean(abs(draws) >= abs(obs), na.rm = TRUE))
}
set.seed(20211130)
bind_rows(EMS = ri_p(ems_es), Syringe = ri_p(syr_es), .id = "outcome")
```

## Sensitivity to trend violations (HonestDiD)

```{r honest-did}
honest <- function(m, n_post = 12) {
  ct <- as.data.frame(coeftable(m)); ct$term <- rownames(ct)
  ct <- ct[grepl("^rel_month::", ct$term), ]
  ct$rel <- as.integer(sub(".*rel_month::(-?[0-9]+):.*", "\\1", ct$term))
  keep <- ct[ct$rel %in% c(-5:-2, 0:(n_post-1)), ]
  keep <- keep[order(keep$rel), ]
  idx  <- match(keep$term, names(coef(m)))
  b <- keep$Estimate; S <- vcov(m)[idx, idx]
  l <- c(rep(0, 6), rep(1/(n_post-6), n_post-6))
  stopifnot(length(b) == 4 + n_post, length(l) == n_post)
  list(orig = constructOriginalCS(b, S, 4, n_post, l_vec = l),
       rm   = createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes(
                b, S, 4, n_post, l_vec = l, Mbarvec = seq(0.25, 2, by = 0.25),
                grid.lb = -5, grid.ub = 5, gridPoints = 1000))
}
h_ems <- honest(es_ems); h_ems$rm
createSensitivityPlot_relativeMagnitudes(h_ems$rm, h_ems$orig)
```

```{r an-negbin-bands}
band_ems_nb <- fenegbin(y ~ i(band, post, ref = "3mi+") | ZIPCODE + month_fe,
                        data = ems_es, offset = ~log(Population), cluster = ~ZIPCODE)
band_syr_nb <- fenegbin(y ~ i(band, post, ref = "3mi+") | ZIPCODE + month_fe,
                        data = syr_es, offset = ~log(Population), cluster = ~ZIPCODE)

tidy_bands <- function(m, lab) {
  ct <- as.data.frame(coeftable(m))
  tibble(outcome = lab,
         term = rownames(ct),
         est  = ct[[1]],
         se   = ct[[2]],
         p    = ct[[ncol(ct)]]) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "^band::")) %>%
    transmute(outcome,
              band = str_extract(term, "(?<=band::)[^:]+"),
              pct  = round(100*(exp(est)-1), 1),
              lo   = round(100*(exp(est - 1.96*se)-1), 1),
              hi   = round(100*(exp(est + 1.96*se)-1), 1),
              p    = round(p, 4))
}

bind_rows(tidy_bands(band_ems_nb, "EMS"),
          tidy_bands(band_syr_nb, "Syringe")) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Distance bands, negative binomial")
```

```{r an-band-ri}
ri_band <- function(p, B = 1000) {
  obs <- coef(fepois(y ~ i(band, post, ref = "3mi+") | ZIPCODE + month_fe,
                     data = p, offset = ~log(Population)))
  obs <- obs[grep("0-0.5mi", names(obs))][1]

                                   levels = c("outer", "inner")))

                         data = dd, offset = ~log(Population)))[1],
             error = function(e) NA_real_)
  })
  tibble(observed = obs, null_sd = sd(draws, na.rm = TRUE),
         ri_p = mean(abs(draws) >= abs(obs), na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

### 2. Local Moran's I, and global Moran's I on rates

```{r an-moran-rates}
# One object, one geometry, one row order, one weights matrix
dat <- nyc_shp_EMS %>%
  mutate(Population = as.numeric(as.character(Population))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Population), Population > 0) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode",
                   "post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode"))) %>%
  left_join(nyc_shp_syringe %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
              select(ZCTA5CE20,
                     pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode,
                     post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode),
            by = "ZCTA5CE20") %>%
  mutate(across(c(pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode,
                  post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode), \(x) replace_na(x, 0)),
         ems_pre  = pre_EMS_counts_per_zipcode      / Population * 1e4,
         ems_post = post_EMS_counts_per_zipcode     / Population * 1e4,
         syr_pre  = pre_syringe_counts_per_zipcode  / Population * 1e4,
         syr_post = post_syringe_counts_per_zipcode / Population * 1e4)

cat("ZIP codes retained:", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Dropped from syringe object:",
    paste(setdiff(nyc_shp_syringe$ZCTA5CE20, dat$ZCTA5CE20), collapse = ", "), "\n")

lw_common <- nb2listw(poly2nb(dat), style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

set.seed(20211130)
mc <- function(x) moran.mc(x, lw_common, nsim = 999, zero.policy = TRUE)
res <- list(`EMS, pre` = mc(dat$ems_pre),  `EMS, post` = mc(dat$ems_post),
            `Syringe, pre` = mc(dat$syr_pre), `Syringe, post` = mc(dat$syr_post))

tibble(series   = names(res),
       morans_i = round(sapply(res, \(x) as.numeric(x$statistic)), 4),
       p        = sapply(res, \(x) x$p.value)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Global Moran's I, rates per 10,000, common ZIP set")
```

```{r an-lisa}
lisa <- localmoran(dat$ems_post, lw_common, zero.policy = TRUE)

dat$lisa_i   <- lisa[, "Ii"]
dat$lisa_p   <- lisa[, ncol(lisa)]
dat$lisa_fdr <- p.adjust(dat$lisa_p, method = "BH")

z  <- scale(dat$ems_post)[, 1]
lz <- lag.listw(lw_common, z, zero.policy = TRUE)
dat$lisa_type <- case_when(
  dat$lisa_fdr >= .05 ~ "Not significant",
  z > 0 & lz > 0 ~ "High-High", z < 0 & lz < 0 ~ "Low-Low",
  z > 0 & lz < 0 ~ "High-Low",  TRUE ~ "Low-High")

cat("Significant before correction:", sum(dat$lisa_p   < .05), "of", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Significant after FDR:        ", sum(dat$lisa_fdr < .05), "of", nrow(dat), "\n")

dat %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(ZIPCODE = ZCTA5CE20, treated,
            rate = round(ems_post, 2), Ii = round(lisa_i, 3),
            p = round(lisa_p, 4), p_fdr = round(lisa_fdr, 4), lisa_type) %>%
  arrange(p) %>% head(15) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Local Moran's I, post-intervention EMS call rate")
```

```{r an-lisa-hosts}
  filter(ZCTA5CE20 %in% c(10033, 10035)) %>%
  transmute(ZIPCODE = ZCTA5CE20, Ii = round(lisa_i, 3),
            p = round(lisa_p, 4), p_fdr = round(lisa_fdr, 4), lisa_type)
```

### 3. Diagnostics for the socioeconomic logistic model

```{r an-scale-check}
close_final <- close_final %>% rename(Median_age = `Median Age`)
socio_vars <- c("non_white", "Poverty_rate", "Insured", "Median_age")
summary(close_final[, socio_vars])
```

```{r an-socio-refit}
socio_dat <- close_final %>% drop_na(all_of(c(socio_vars, "treated")))

socio_model <- glm(treated ~ non_white + Poverty_rate + Insured + Median_age,
                   family = binomial, data = socio_dat)
summary(socio_model)
```

```{r an-vif}
tibble(term = names(car::vif(socio_model)),
       VIF  = round(as.numeric(car::vif(socio_model)), 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Variance inflation factors (>5 problematic, >10 severe)")
```

```{r an-gof}
null_fit <- glm(treated ~ 1, family = binomial, data = socio_dat)
mcfadden <- as.numeric(1 - logLik(socio_model) / logLik(null_fit))
hl <- hoslem.test(socio_model$y, fitted(socio_model), g = 8)
lr <- anova(null_fit, socio_model, test = "Chisq")

tibble(statistic = c("McFadden pseudo-R2", "Hosmer-Lemeshow X2",
                     "Hosmer-Lemeshow p", "Likelihood-ratio p"),
       value = round(c(mcfadden, hl$statistic, hl$p.value, lr$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]), 4)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Goodness of fit")
```

```{r an-bivariate}
map_dfr(socio_vars, function(v) {
  m  <- glm(as.formula(paste("treated ~", v)), family = binomial, data = socio_dat)
  ct <- summary(m)$coefficients[2, ]
  tibble(term = v, coef = ct[1], se = ct[2], p_raw = ct[4])
}) %>%
  mutate(p_bonf  = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "bonferroni"),
         mult    = ifelse(term == "Median_age", 1, 0.10),
         OR      = exp(mult * coef),
         OR_lo   = exp(mult * (coef - 1.96*se)),
         OR_hi   = exp(mult * (coef + 1.96*se)),
         across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))) %>%
  select(-mult) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Bivariate models with Bonferroni correction")
```

### 4. Co-intervention sensitivity test

```{r an-confound-zips}
sites_scs <- read_csv("data/scs_locations.csv")
sx <- sites_scs %>% filter(`Site Type` != "SCS") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(nyc_shp_EMS))

sx_zip <- nyc_shp_EMS$ZCTA5CE20[lengths(st_intersects(nyc_shp_EMS, st_buffer(sx, 1000))) > 0]

cat("ZIPs with a syringe service program:", paste(sort(sx_zip), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Of which are comparison ZIPs:",
    paste(sort(setdiff(sx_zip, geo$ZIPCODE[geo$treated == 1])), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r an-confound-test}
grab <- function(m, pat) {
  nm <- grep(pat, names(coef(m)), value = TRUE)
  if (!length(nm)) return(tibble(coef = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  tibble(coef = coef(m)[[nm[1]]], se = se(m)[[nm[1]]], p = pvalue(m)[[nm[1]]])
}

confound_test <- function(p, lab) {
  p <- p %>% mutate(other_site = as.integer(ZIPCODE %in% sx_zip))
  m_ctrl <- fepois(y ~ treated:post + other_site:post | ZIPCODE + month_fe,
                   data = p, offset = ~log(Population), cluster = ~ZIPCODE)
  m_drop <- fepois(y ~ treated:post | ZIPCODE + month_fe,
                   data = p %>% filter(treated == 1 | !ZIPCODE %in% sx_zip),
                   offset = ~log(Population), cluster = ~ZIPCODE)
  bind_rows(
    tibble(outcome = lab, spec = "Control for other sites") %>% bind_cols(grab(m_ctrl, "treated")),
    tibble(outcome = lab, spec = "Other-site coefficient")  %>% bind_cols(grab(m_ctrl, "other_site")),
    tibble(outcome = lab, spec = "Drop those ZIPs")         %>% bind_cols(grab(m_drop, "treated")))
}

bind_rows(confound_test(ems_es, "EMS calls"),
          confound_test(syr_es, "311 syringes")) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100*(exp(coef)-1), 1),
         lo  = round(100*(exp(coef - 1.96*se)-1), 1),
         hi  = round(100*(exp(coef + 1.96*se)-1), 1),
         across(c(coef, se, p), \(x) round(x, 4))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Sensitivity to other harm-reduction sites")
```

### 5. Table 4 at the correct scaling

```{r an-table4}
rng <- max(socio_dat$non_white, na.rm = TRUE)
scale_note <- dplyr::case_when(rng <= 1.5 ~ "proportion (0-1)",
                               rng <= 15  ~ "tens of percentage points (0-10)",
                               TRUE       ~ "percentage (0-100)")
mult_pct <- dplyr::case_when(rng <= 1.5 ~ 0.10, rng <= 15 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 10)
cat("non_white is on the", scale_note, "scale; using multiplier", mult_pct, "\n")

ct <- summary(socio_model)$coefficients
table4 <- tibble(term = rownames(ct)[-1], b = ct[-1, 1],
                 se = ct[-1, 2], p = ct[-1, 4]) %>%
  mutate(unit  = ifelse(term == "Median_age", "per year", "per 10 percentage points"),
         mult  = ifelse(term == "Median_age", 1, mult_pct),
         OR    = exp(mult * b),
         OR_lo = exp(mult * (b - 1.96*se)),
         OR_hi = exp(mult * (b + 1.96*se)))

table4 %>%
  transmute(Variable = term, Unit = unit,
            `b (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", b, se),
            `OR [95% CI]` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", OR, OR_lo, OR_hi),
            p = sprintf("%.3f", p)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 4, regenerated from the fitted model")
```

```{r export-figures, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

save_base <- function(n, expr, w = 9, h = 5) {
  f <- file.path("figures", paste0("Fig ", n))
  pdf(paste0(f, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h)
  expr; dev.off()
  png(paste0(f, ".png"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = 600, type = "quartz")
  expr; dev.off()
}

save_gg <- function(n, plot, w = 6, h = 8) {
  f <- file.path("figures", paste0("Fig ", n))
  ggsave(paste0(f, ".pdf"), plot, width = w, height = h)        # uses pdf()
  ggsave(paste0(f, ".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
}

save_base(6, iplot(es_ems_full,
  main = "EMS drug-related calls, full study period",
  xlab = "Months relative to SCS opening",
  ylab = "Log rate ratio vs. month -1"))

save_base(7, iplot(es_ems,
  main = "EMS drug-related calls, pandemic months excluded",
  xlab = "Months relative to SCS opening",
  ylab = "Log rate ratio vs. month -1"))

save_gg(3, p_map)    # choropleth — assign your Figure 3 ggplot to p_map
save_gg(4, p_lisa)
save_gg(5, p_lisa_syr)
```
